name: Mir Post Importer
author: mirmehranarjmand

sections.description:
Mir Post Importer allows you to securely retrieve posts from another WordPress website using the WordPress REST API.

Simply enter the REST API URL, username and password of the remote website, then display posts anywhere on your website.

Features:

  • Secure REST API communication
  • Supports HTTP Basic Authentication
  • Compatible with MirSecure and similar authentication plugins
  • Elementor widget included
  • Built-in cache system
  • Easy setup
  • Lightweight and fast

External Services

This plugin connects to a remote WordPress REST API to retrieve posts for display.

It sends a request to the configured WordPress REST API endpoint whenever posts need to be refreshed after the cache expires.

Data sent:
* The HTTP request to the configured REST API endpoint.

This service is provided by the website owner.

Terms of Service:
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Mir Post Importer settings.
  4. Configure the remote REST API URL.
  5. Enter the username and password.
  6. Configure cache duration.
  7. Use the Elementor widget to display posts.
sections.faq:
Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. The plugin includes a native Elementor widget.

Does it support authenticated APIs?

Yes. It supports WordPress websites protected by HTTP Basic Authentication.

Does it cache posts?

Yes. Posts are cached to reduce API requests and improve performance.
